# Inge Nordgaard Lassen

Inge Nordgaard Lassen is a Cheflæge (chief physician) and medical doctor serving as a steering committee member for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national clinical quality improvement registry for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1]. She is based at [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], which was the largest treating region in the DANIBD network during the 2022–2023 reporting period [^src1].

Lassen's role places her within a leadership structure representing medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation across all five Danish regions, supplemented by epidemiological and data management support from RKKP (the Danish Clinical Quality Program Registry) [^src1]. During the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, the DANIBD registry documented treatment of 33,381 patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) across the Danish regions, with Region Hovedstaden accounting for the largest patient volume [^src1]. Within this registry, biological treatments (BMSL) were administered to 10,523 patients, with infliximab being the most frequently used therapy [^src1].
